initial_cap.rationale: Conservative proposed wrapper budget, not profiled engine capacity or statistical guarantee.

admission: Unique nonempty string node identifiers; exact typed directed edges and explicit node list including isolates.
Acyclic finite graph; distinct observed singleton exposure and outcome; no latent, bidirected, selection, undirected or ambiguous marks.
No post-action adjustment variable; reject descendants of exposure and overlap with exposure/outcome.
Graph is a supplied scientific assumption with provenance; passing graph checks does not establish graph truth.
Initial operation requests Adjustment(variant=minimal). Explicit whitelist excludes all, minimal_variance, discovery, learned-DAG selection, effect estimation and live model operations.
call: Construct a fresh DAG with explicit roles, invoke Adjustment(variant=minimal).identify; retain original graph and exact node-role map.
response: success=true -> require a graph and observed adjustment set, verify unchanged nodes/edges/exposure/outcome roles, then independently validate descendant exclusion and d-separation in graph with outgoing exposure edges removed.
Any exception, source warning, invalid type, timeout, nonfinite metadata or failed independent validation -> diagnostic refusal/unavailable; never empty set or zero effect.
Empty adjustment set is a successful scientific result only when separately verified, not the same as failed/null result.
Output is a verified candidate adjustment set relative to the supplied graph; no numerical effect, confidence interval or actual causal truth.

conversion.primary: Named directed edges and node-role records; preserve node order and isolates.
conversion.forbidden: No PDAG.to_dag/to_cpdag coercion, binary-matrix direction guessing or automatic latent deletion.
conversion.transport: Proposed library result, bounded JSON CLI and MCP result share target/graph identities and dispositions; no implemented endpoint claimed.

behavioral_oracle.anchor: Two independent d-separation definitions over all543 four-node DAGs; exact mediator and extension counterexamples

oracle_code.anchor: Project-only finite graph and SEM checks

minimum_future_fixtures: Observed confounder requires Z; mediated chain uses empty set and rejects M; collider adjustment rejected.
Multiple inclusion-minimal sets accepted by property rather than requiring one arbitrary order; minimum-size promise forbidden.
Disconnected graphs, isolates, Unicode string names and every node permutation preserve semantic edges.
Latent/mixed/partial graph, duplicate role, cyclic input and unsupported variant refused before engine call.
Engine warning, no-method result, exception, timeout and changed graph after return retained separately.
Package/dependency lock and source revision hash recorded; upstream tests and actual CLI/library roundtrip required before runtime claim.
owner_obligations: Research owner specifies assumed graph, target, clock and admissible controls.
Adapter owner enforces contracts, notice retention, dependency license/build review and isolated compatible environment.
Reviewer compares actual outputs against the independent oracle before runtime acceptance; author design selection is not independent certification.
revisit_trigger: A future pinned upgrade or new graph/method path requires source, oracle, dependency and conversion review; runtime claims additionally require executed fixtures.
integration_allowed_scope: This restricted graph-candidate prototype implementation only; no blanket pgmpy adoption.
